notes: This paper studies wheat grain yield responses to biostimulants (Kelpak/SWE and Asahi) applied with or without herbicides (MCPA+dicamba, dicamba+triasulfuron, florasulam+2,4-D) in two modes: tank mixture and sequential application. Li 2022 selected only 6 Kelpak (SWE) observations from this paper. Our extractor found 23 JSON obs covering both biostimulants across 3 herbicide types and 2 years (2014, 2015). Key issues: (1) The GT control means (~0.674-0.727 t/ha) are approximately 8-9x smaller than our extracted means (4.49-6.16 t/ha), suggesting a unit discrepancy (possibly GT stores in some scaled unit or the paper reports data for a different metric/plot size). (2) The GT has 3 distinct ctrl-mean groups but our extractor only found 2 year groups (2014, 2015); the third group (ctrl=0.674) likely represents a 2016 experimental year or a separate block not captured. (3) The GT appears to select only 1 specific herbicide+Kelpak combination per application method per year (likely MCPA+dicamba based on effect size proximity), while our extractor captured all 3 herbicide combinations. (4) Effect size agreement is poor for the matched pairs (especially pairs 435-436 where signs disagree), which is consistent with the magnitude discrepancy and possible year mismatch. Confidence for all matched pairs is low due to these systematic discrepancies.
